text.tspan: AWS Storage Gateway: bridge on-premises apps to cloud storage
Hybrid cloud: part on-prem, part AWS (long migrations, security, compliance, IT strategy). S3 is proprietary (not NFS like EFS), so how do on-prem apps use it?
Use cases: disaster recovery · backup & restore · tiered storage · on-premises cache & low-latency file access.
AWS Cloud (HTTPS, Internet or Direct Connect)
IAM role per gateway · SMB + AD auth
Block storage backed by S3, backups as EBS snapshots (restore on-prem or as EBS)
cached: data in S3, most recent data cached locally (1 GiB-32 TiB, x32 = 1 PiB)
stored: ALL data on-prem, scheduled backups to S3 (1 GiB-16 TiB, x32 = 512 TiB)
Virtual tapes (100 GiB-15 TiB) in S3
same tape processes, leading backup apps
FSx File Gateway: on-prem SMB cache in front of FSx for
Windows. No longer available to NEW customers (AWS
recommends using FSx for Windows directly).
Deploy as a VM (VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, Linux KVM,
Nutanix), an EC2 instance, VMware Cloud on AWS, or a
hardware appliance. Data encrypted in transit (SSL/TLS).
